text:
Chris (Sales): quick handover for Atlas Health (acct: ATLAS-245). signed today; ARR $96k. go-live target: 2026-05-18. main POC = Nina Park (integration lead).

Chris (Sales): key flags — they require EU data residency, Okta SSO, and a private VPC deploy (legal asked for strict audit logs). They will use embeddings + chat for internal SOP search, ~120 reqs/min peak.

Miguel (CS): thanks — i'll own onboarding. setting up tech kickoff w/ Nina. target dates OK but lets confirm infra lead. i’ll create the onboarding runbook and share dev creds.

Jan (CS Lead): renewal window in 10 months — mark as expansion opportunity (security/compliance upsell). risk: if latency >150ms at 95th pct we lose pilot. add performance evals and alerting to playbook.

Tom (Eng): noted. i'll pick up infra triage + model routing questions. can you drop sample payloads and average sequence length? also: are they ok with quantized model variants or need FP models for fidelity?

Chris (Sales): payloads attached in the contract appendix (see link) — mostly short queries, avg tokens ~60, embeddings batch size 1. they insisted on deterministic replies for some flows.

Rina (Support): i'll own post-go-live runbook and 24/7 on-call handoff for first 30 days. please tag me on any infra tickets. will prepare escalation doc to Eng + SRE.

Miguel (CS): tentative owners + next steps: 1) Miguel = onboarding owner; 2) Tom = infra/triage owner; 3) Rina = support/runbook; 4) Jan = renewal/expansion owner. i'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for next Tue.

Chris (Sales): sending intro to Nina now — cc'ing legal and security for the VPC/KMS questions. :email:  

onboard-bot: New onboarding runbook created: https://redwood.internal/onboards/ATLAS-245 (private).

Miguel (CS): quick checklist i'm going to use — ping if anything missing:
```
- create customer org + env
- provision VPC + KMS keys
- validate Okta SSO (SAML metadata)
- deploy private control plane (staging)
- perf smoke tests (95p latency)
- embed sample data and run E2E flows
- capture initial quality eval (prompt set)
```

Tom (Eng): i'll open infra ticket: INF-5723. dropping initial notes there. can someone upload a few real-ish anonymized requests to the ticket so i can reproduce latency patterns?

Chris (Sales): uploading a dev sample now. Nina will also share redacted logs.

Jan (CS Lead): also adding a short prompt set for quality monitoring — we should baseline before any quantization. Miguel, can you add the eval targets to the runbook?

Miguel (CS): yes — baseline eval + weekly regression checks. adding alerts for token usage spikes and latency >120ms for now.

Rina (Support): will prepare runbook sections: "first 24h triage", "common errors", "escalation to INF". linking to PagerDuty rotation.

Tom (Eng): thanks — once we have sample payloads i'll repro on dedicated pool and share perf numbers. if we see >120ms at 95p we will enable tailored batching and prefix caching.

Chris (Sales): final ask from customer: SOC2 + audit log export cadence. legal wants a weekly snapshot. tagging security for KMS retention policy.

Jan (CS Lead): action items (high level): Miguel schedule kickoff + share runbook (owner: Miguel). Tom open INF ticket + reproduce (owner: Tom). Rina build support runbook + PD rotation (owner: Rina). Chris follow up on legal KMS questions (owner: Chris). set 1-week followup after tech kickoff.

Miguel (CS): i've scheduled kickoff: Tue 2026-03-30 10:00 CET. invite sent to Nina + Chris + Tom + Rina + Jan.

Chris (Sales): thanks team :thumbsup: — i'll close the sales handoff doc. tagging @Tom and @Rina for immediate asks.

Rina (Support): got it. prepping PD schedule and initial SLA doc.

Tom (Eng): will post INF-5723 link when created. expect initial repro by EOD Fri.

Miguel (CS): closing note — customer is high-touch and likely to expand to 3 more internal teams if the pilot meets latency & fidelity targets. prioritize perf and auditability.

Chris (Sales): agreed — keeping renewal/expansion on Jan's radar. thanks everyone.
